## 🐛 Bug Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## 🔁 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Type or trigger '....'
4. See error

## 🎯 Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## 📸 Screenshots or Recordings
If applicable, add screenshots, screen recordings, or GIFs to help explain your problem.

## 💻 Environment & Device Information
- **OS**: [e.g. Windows 11, macOS Sequoia, Ubuntu 24.04, iOS, Android]
- **Browser**: [e.g. Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, Arc]
- **Browser Version**: [e.g. 128.0]
- **Display Resolution & Scale**: [e.g. 1920x1080 @ 100%, 2560x1440 @ 125%]
- **Input Method**: [e.g. Physical Mechanical Keyboard, Laptop Keyboard, Touchscreen]

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g. browser console errors, active game mode, BYOK provider).
